audit.summary: Login screen is functional with correct OTP flow and role routing, but exposes debug preview credentials and a phase label directly in the production UI — a security and polish concern.

findings.title: Preview credentials exposed in production UI
findings.details: The login screen renders a full list of role-specific test credentials (phone numbers + OTP '123456') as visible on-screen text. This is a developer/QA convenience that must be gated behind a debug build flag before any production release.
findings.expected: No hardcoded credentials or OTP hints visible to end users in a production or staging build.
findings.observed: 10 role credentials (Guard 9999999999, Supervisor 8888888888, Manager 7777777777, HRMS 6666666666, Buyer 5555555555, AC tech 2222222222, Pest 1111111111, Delivery 2121212121, Service boy 2323232323, Supplier 4444444444, Vendor 3333333333) with shared OTP '123456' rendered in plain text on the screen.

findings.title: 'PHASE 1' implementation label visible in UI
findings.details: The string 'PHASE 1' is rendered as visible UI text on the login screen. Internal project phase labels are engineering/product artefacts and should not surface to end users.
findings.expected: No internal phase or sprint markers present in any user-facing view.
findings.observed: Text 'PHASE 1' visible as a screen element.

findings.title: Phone input pre-filled with Supervisor preview number
findings.details: The input field shows '+91 98765 43210' (i.e., 9876543210, the Supervisor preview number) already populated. Unclear whether this is a leftover value from a prior automated test step or a default. Should be blank on fresh navigation to the login screen.
findings.expected: Phone input field empty on initial screen load.

findings.title: India number normalisation helper text present
findings.details: The screen correctly instructs users that 10-digit India numbers will be auto-prefixed with +91, matching expected localisation behaviour.
findings.expected: User guidance for India number format available.
findings.observed: Instruction text present: 'India numbers can be entered as `9876543210` and we’ll convert them to `+91` automatically.'

findings.title: Role-based workspace routing intent present
findings.details: The screen copy confirms OTP sign-in will route users into their 'correct mobile workspace', consistent with the multi-role architecture described in the PRD.
findings.expected: Login flow routes authenticated users to role-specific workspaces.
findings.observed: Screen copy: 'FacilityPro will use this session to route you into the correct mobile workspace.'

payload.notes: Entering the guard preview phone number to proceed with authentication.

audit.summary: Login screen renders correctly with phone/OTP flow and QA role-preview shortcuts. No PRD violations detected against the provided Out-of-Scope section.

findings.title: QA preview shortcuts visible on login screen
findings.details: Ten 'Preview <role>' buttons are rendered on the login screen (buyer, AC technician, pest control, delivery boy, service boy, supplier, vendor, security supervisor, society manager, HRMS employee). These are test-harness shortcuts (resource IDs prefixed qa_login_preview_*) and should not appear in a production build.
findings.expected: Preview shortcuts present only in debug/QA builds; absent in production release.
findings.observed: All 10 preview-role buttons visible alongside the standard Send OTP flow.

findings.title: Phone number pre-filled with test number 9999999999
findings.details: The phone input (qa_login_phone_input) is pre-populated with '9999999999', consistent with an automated QA run. No impact on functional correctness.
findings.expected: Empty or QA-seeded phone number depending on run mode.

findings.title: PRD chunk covers Out-of-Scope only — no login spec provided
findings.details: The supplied PRD chunk (Section 10) defines web-only features and does not specify login screen requirements. Full conformance check against login UX/copy/flow spec is not possible with this chunk alone.
findings.expected: PRD section covering authentication flow (phone entry, OTP, error states).
findings.observed: Only Section 10 (Out of Scope) provided; no conflicts with it were found on this screen.

payload.notes: Request an OTP to proceed with the authentication process using the pre-filled phone number.
